description:
She wakes up at the scene of her affair—only to find her husband’s sword pointed at her. To avoid execution, she demands a divorce, but her cold and ruthless husband unexpectedly refuses. Instead of rejecting her in disgust, he begins to show an unsettling obsession, turning their relationship into something far more complicated and dangerous.
